title: Google's AI Turns Your Day Into a Storybook, Now in India
description:
Google's experimental Dreambeans app is now in India, its first country outside the US. It builds illustrated stories from the Google apps you choose to connect, with no prompt needed.
We bust two myths: it speaks 14 languages (English plus 13 Indian languages) but only one at a time, and it's free on Android and iOS for adults 18+. Google warns it can still get things wrong.
